messages:
jane.docs: quick note 1 opened a PR to fix the API reference for /v1/generate. docs still show `input` (string) and `model` but the canonical request shape is `inputs` (array) and `model_id`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102

tom.eng: can you paste the bad vs good curl examples so i can smoke test staging?

jane.docs: bad (current site):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model": "redwood/gpt-3x", "input": "Summarize this..."}'
```
good (runtime + SDK canonical):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model_id": "redwood/gpt-3x", "inputs": ["Summarize this..."]}'
```

raj.sdk: our JS SDK still accepts `input` for backwards compat and maps it to `inputs` internally, but docs should show the canonical shape. i'll update the SDK snippet to use `inputs: ["..."]` and add a short compat note. PR coming.

emma.prod: please add a short migration note at the top of the API ref: "Previously `input` (string) was accepted; switch to `inputs` (array). SDKs accept both for now." also mention `model_id` rename. we'll include this in release notes.

tom.eng: ran the good curl against staging  returned 200 with `choices` array. sample response looks like: `{\"choices\": [{\"text\": \"TL;DR...\"}]}` i'll drop it into the docs PR as the approved example.

ci-bot: docs/link-check: failed in docs/pull/1102 1 broken anchor to /sdk/js#examples.

raj.sdk: i'll fix the README anchor and open a small SDK PR to update the docs link.

jane.docs: plan: land docs PR after link fix + smoke test. tagging the SDK PR so we coordinate the snippet change. thanks all.
